Goals.Title: Require compliant devices
Goals.Summary: Only devices that Intune manages and marks compliant can reach Microsoft 365.

Goals.Title: Require managed devices
Goals.Summary: Only devices that Intune marks compliant or that are hybrid joined to Microsoft Entra ID can reach Microsoft 365.

Goals.Title: Use risk-based Conditional Access
Goals.Summary: Users and sign-ins that ID Protection rates risky must prove themselves with MFA or a secure password change before they get in.

Goals.Title: Require phishing-resistant MFA
Goals.Summary: Every user signs in with a passkey, Windows Hello for Business or another method that a phishing site can't replay.

Goals.Title: Replace standing admin access with PIM
Goals.Summary: Administrators activate privileged roles when they need them, and only the emergency access accounts keep standing access.

Goals.Title: Protect sign-in tokens on Windows
Goals.Summary: Sign-in tokens for Exchange, SharePoint and Teams are bound to the Windows device they were issued to, so they can't be replayed elsewhere.

Goals.Title: Authenticate mail from your domains
Goals.Summary: Receivers can tell real mail from your domains from spoofed mail, and reject the spoofed mail.

Goals.Title: Use Defender device risk in compliance
Goals.Summary: Devices that Defender for Endpoint rates risky become noncompliant, so the compliant-device Conditional Access policy blocks them.
